name: rsidc-mall-entra-gateway
description:
AgentCore Gateway (MCP), Entra ID version: the same 4 mall tools, per-user RBAC via Cedar on Entra's native App Role claim roles. No Cognito.
Auth: Bearer Microsoft Entra ID v2 access token (tenant <entra-tenant-id>); allowedAudience = rsidc-mall-api <mall-api-app-id>; Cedar policy engine <entra-policy-engine-id>
Tools: mall___get_mall_list, mall___get_footfall_summary, mall___get_hourly_traffic, mall___get_zone_comparison
Owner: Jacky Wu (rsidc PoC)
